name: Identity strip
summary: The "Submitting as {emoji} {name}" header, for a slide that genuinely needs one, with the one anonymous rule every slide shares.
highlights: "Submitting as" header when a slide needs one
One anonymous rule: no name, no emoji
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-identity-strip> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Eyebrow
spec.value: 12px semibold uppercase, 0.06em tracking, the ink at 60%

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: name / emoji
props.desc: The participant's name and host emoji; no name means anonymous and hides the emoji

props.name: anonymous-name
props.desc: Shown in place of an absent name (translated)

props.name: eyebrow
props.desc: Optional status line above, such as "Round 2"

whenToUse.when: a round that must show who is answering (a team game)
every other slide: the audience app already shows who the participant joined as

opinion.note: Prefer a name the participant typed over the raw host login where one exists. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the light-deck example with no deck applied (DS defaults).
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-identity-strip[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;function q(s){return r&&r.querySelector(s)}function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var i=cs(q('.identity'));var e=cs(q('.eyebrow'));return{size:i.fontSize,ink:i.color,eyebrowSize:e.fontSize,nameWeight:cs(q('strong')).fontWeight,lineHeight:i.lineHeight};})()
